writeup: TIC 59488906 is a candidate eclipsing binary star with an orbital period of 27.874392 days and a primary eclipse depth of 4.21 percent. The system was identified through automated analysis of TESS photometry data and pixel-level image analysis, achieving a very high detection significance of 3299.3 in the box-least-squares search. The candidate does not appear in six major variable-star catalogs. However, alternating eclipses show significantly different depths, suggesting the initial period was underestimated; the corrected period accounts for this asymmetry. No secondary eclipse was detected. While pixel-level confirmation shows a strong signal, the alternating eclipse-depth pattern remains an open question requiring further investigation.
